referenceInstalledFile.scope: Installed file identity; COM can be served by an already running IDM instance.

finalActualClients.scope: Owned loopback POST comparison; private UDM catalog and named IDM fixture downloads only. No settings, queue-start or quit commands sent to IDM.

installed IDM via published COM API

referenceDifferences: UDM preserves the exact declared 25-byte ASCII API body. IDM sent 26 bytes with the hash of that body plus a trailing NUL. The response fixture returns a fixed payload, so this compares response decoding, not equivalence of arbitrary form submissions.
The identity origin ignores byte ranges; IDM made additional POST range attempts. UDM made one POST per paired download. Replaying a business form is not a parity target.
fixtureCorrections: Initial form fixture compile lacked fstream; corrected before execution.

Initial integration reached 17 passing checks, then attempted a checksum edit that active prefetch intentionally rejects. The corrected fixture verifies rejection/rollback and successful subsequent confirmation.
An initial direct UI invocation omitted its reference argument and produced no evidence. Only the subsequent repository runner result with 256 checks is counted.
limitations: Fresh POST requests remain excluded from speculative prefetch. Pre-Start size is qualified for already received and verified form responses.
Decoding still follows network EOF; no paired speed or latency acceptance is claimed.
Other HTTP content encodings, broader form/redirect combinations, large staged-body resource behavior and crash/disk-fault injection remain separate gates.
The installed app and extension have not been upgraded by this work.
cleanup: Small fixture artifacts retained. No FFmpeg copies, installer creation or retry of the previously rejected cleanup.
